lineage.historical_negative: AT AS-based learned and forced inverse 0/48 fresh TRAIN, oracle-only 48/48; alternate Wingless 12bit 41/48 FP6 but lost original accepted long positive; retained. Do not optimize against consumed cohorts.
lineage.reuse_rule: Reuse historical originals only by immutable commit+blob and authenticated raw artifacts; bounded delta; fail closed on identity drift; focused checks plus one complete final integration regression.

source.origin: Exact frozen AT source graph construction; rebind only disjoint independent identities. Source truth, positive/negative pairing and true inverses evaluator-only.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Shared genuinely trained metric and attention embeddings over raw public demonstrations may transfer unfamiliar operators and separate sample-identifiability failures from representation failure without a hand-coded affine/Feistel inverse.
Yggdrasil.shared_training: 2 deterministic passes over source-new TRAIN 48 tasks, each task limited to first 20 public FIT input/output demonstrations. Shared training supervision permitted only public output->input pairs, no true inverse or graph truth. Within-task learned attention/metric constructed only from public FIT. Last 4 public CHECK examples calibrate abstention only.
Yggdrasil.model_input: Only PUBLIC output and input demonstration bits, and PUBLIC encoded graph edges. No source operator labels, reverse maps, paired case truth, evaluator case IDs, hidden inverse, future DEV samples, or source class ID. Score source-blind via original unchanged AG 7 active + 9 retained prediction.
Yggdrasil.weights: Bounded deterministic parameter initialization and per-example supervised gradient update. No explicit affine or Feistel grammar, exhaustive inverse search or source-generated inverse in model.
Yggdrasil.model_resource: Report model weights, per-task public support storage, float activations, training gradient operations, per-graph inference cost, separate Python peak memory and CPU/wall, OS peak process memory with cross-OS caveats.
Yggdrasil.eligible_TRAIN: On fresh 48 paired TRAIN cases, FP=0, positive sensitivity >0 and paired-correct strictly above the strongest eligible same-source source-blind learned control. Preserve full 8-arm grid and all negatives; oracle ceiling never eligible.
Yggdrasil.eligible_DEV: Only after frozen selected identity and independent qualifier, exactly one first-use DEV. Never infer eligibility from development data.

Wingless.hypothesis: A strictly one-state 12-bit causal witness may discriminate false paths from authentic continuous handoffs by using local compressed-consistency evidence at each transition and conditional public sibling disagreement.
Wingless.candidate_mechanism: New locally computed 12bit causal evidence penalty on the original packed forward path. No extra retained node state, no alternative state or path cache; any siblings/successors scanned directly from existing public edge index and discarded within hop. No source truth/operator/class fed to predictor.
comparators: fixed previous AT 12bit checksum alternatives diagnosis
16bit raw overcapacity diagnostic only, not candidate
Wingless.eligibility: Strict FP reduction vs original same-source gamma0; paired-correct no lower; every individually accepted original 13-15-hop positive preserved. No exception on equal FP, no source oracle in model.
Wingless.resource: Report model-only edge/affinity/extra evidence operation counts, CPU/wall/peak Python allocation, actual RSS with limitations, and retained one-state invariant.
Wingless.DEV_first_use: No DEV for F124-AU until frozen selection and independently qualified preflight, even if TRAIN positive.

qualification.fail_closed: No automatic source reseed, parameter retuning, scientific admission, optimizer promotion, production activation, cross-project mutation or accepted-ref merge. Invalid data, failed tests or excessive original capacity stops the gate.
